prompt: Complete ScoreSerializer so toBytes serializes a Score object to a byte array with ObjectOutputStream and fromBytes deserializes it back with ObjectInputStream.
explanation: Java serialization turns any Serializable object graph into bytes: ObjectOutputStream.writeObject encodes the object, and wrapping it around a ByteArrayOutputStream captures those bytes in memory instead of a file. Deserialization mirrors it -- ObjectInputStream.readObject returns an Object that you cast back to the real type. The try-with-resources blocks make sure the streams are flushed and closed.
hints: Create a ByteArrayOutputStream, wrap it in an ObjectOutputStream, and call writeObject(s).
After the ObjectOutputStream is closed, ByteArrayOutputStream.toByteArray() gives you the byte[].
For reading: new ObjectInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(b)), call readObject(), and cast to Score.
